detail:
Decisions: Chose to record only the rationale_source defect in this store and deliberately withhold the benchmark-harness scorer findings (28-mutant pass, 4 surviving gaps, 2472-session spread analysis) — those describe src/analyzer/record-content.ts in /Users/dave/code/twining-benchmark-harness, which has its own .twining store, and filing them here would repeat the misfiling already visible in the 5dee214 records. Rejected alternative: record everything here so nothing is lost, reason_rejected: a finding filed against a repo that does not contain the file it names is worse than no finding, because twining_why will surface it as a constraint on a path that does not exist.
Findings: warning: rationale_source is absent as a FIELD on 456 of 456 decision records in this store, including 01KZ77G2NF1SFW4RXMS6B7HTYM written today by the running server via twining_record with a genuinely authored rationale. Running the repo's own parseDecision on that record's exact text returns rationale_source='authored', so the parser marks it correctly and the value is lost somewhere between parseDecision and the persisted record. Every consumer that reads the marker off committed records currently sees 'unknown provenance' universally.; The drop is NOT a missing-feature/version gap. ab48f81 (which introduced rationale_source) is an ancestor of the 2.6.0 tag 20ec0ef, and the marketplace bundle at ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/twining-marketplace/plugin/server/twining-server.mjs contains the whole chain including the forwarding spread 'rationale_source ? { rationale_source: input.rationale_source } : {}'. Source path also looks correct end to end: record-tools.ts:95 and :140 set it, decisions.ts:354 forwards it, sqlite-stores.ts:167 spreads input, record-export.ts:93 writes the decision verbatim. So the live behaviour contradicts what the code at HEAD does — one of those layers is not the code actually running.; Candidate cause, NOT confirmed: ~/.claude/settings.json:33 has \"twining@twining-marketplace\": false, so the server serving this session is not the marketplace bundle. captureProvenance (e3cd5f3) and assembled_before (b2d9d70) both predate ab48f81, so a server can emit provenance and assembled_before — which today's records do — while still lacking rationale_source. Identifying the binary actually bound to this session would settle it.; Store composition observed while checking: 456 decisions, 326 carry a provenance object (branch/commit_sha/recorded_at), 130 have none. provenance is git provenance and is unrelated to rationale provenance — do not mistake one for the other when looking for the marker.; Scored this store with the harness's new content analyzer: value=60, measuredWeight=1.00, rationale term 0.482, alternatives 0.396, scope 0.860, affected 0.817, postValue 73, 2 duplicate summaries out of 456. The rationale term is pinned at the 0.5 unknown-provenance ceiling purely because of the missing marker, so 60 understates the store and will move once the marker lands.
summary: Found that rationale_source is emitted by the parser but absent from 100% of persisted decision records (0/456), including ones written today — the marker is dropped downstream of parseDecision.
